02 / How I work

Think it through.
Then get your hands on it.

My work moves between mechanical design, electronics, software, and creative practice. Each gives me another way to approach a problem.

01

Design with purpose.

Start with the person, the constraints, and the question worth solving.

  • SolidWorks & Fusion 360
  • 2D drafting & GD&T
  • Unity Game Engine
02

Build to understand.

Prototype the parts that matter. Learn from the fit, the wiring, and the first run.

  • 3D printing & laser cutting
  • Electronics assembly
  • Arduino/C++ & automotive repair
03

Keep refining.

Measure what happens, question the assumptions, and make the next iteration better.

  • Python & data pipelines
  • Sewing & photography
  • Piano, violin, guitar & jarana/requinto
03 / Beyond the workbench

Engineering is one part
of the picture.

Music, sewing, photography, and community work keep me curious about how things are made—and who they're made for. I'm interested in clean energy, sustainable infrastructure, and practical ideas that improve everyday life.
